- **Birthplace:** Delta State, Nigeria (specifically Burutu Local Government Area).
- **Chief Judge of Delta State:** **Hon. Justice Abiodun Smith** (served as Chief Judge of Delta State from 1 October 2011 until 4 May 2015).
